purpose.summary: Bind the successful public review and main-branch CI for the accepted optional Chronik indexing implementation and advance its public delivery gate from active to verified without overstating the evidence.
scope: Record the exact reviewed and merged commits, shared tree, workflow identities, run identities, job identities and successful public conclusions for ERGON-CHANGE-0037.
Advance only the optional-indexing delivery gate to verified while keeping its knowledge status at Observed and its evidence ceiling at component observation.
Regenerate the visual roadmap from the machine-readable cockpit event and correct the public README to describe the accepted implementation and its remaining limits.
exclusions: No node, Chronik, consensus, validation, mempool, API, wallet, P2P, activation, network-identity or mainnet parameter code is changed.
No raw CI log, runner image, binary, build output, private path, operator data or secret is included.
No independent reproduction, deterministic build, production readiness, testnet activation or mainnet activation is claimed.

limitations: The evidence record binds public GitHub Actions metadata and successful conclusions, not raw logs, binaries, runner images or an independently reproduced environment.
Ubuntu package resolution outside the locked Cargo graph is not byte-pinned, so this closure cannot claim deterministic builds or Reproduced knowledge.
Optional indexing remains explicit local-regtest-only and has no served API, mempool index, wallet integration or production deployment contract.
counterevidence: The accepted implementation previously required several public CI portability corrections before the complete workflow passed; the closure preserves the exact successful workflow identities instead of erasing that history.
Publication-gate success establishes repository consistency, not runtime behavior; runtime claims are limited to the separate successful Chronik workflow runs.
No different reviewer or environment has independently rebuilt and rerun the accepted tree, so the knowledge status remains Observed.
